text:
Power 
 Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This equipment used for clean 
 intake water from any deposits suspended
This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, which 
 must be carried out every month as indicated by M1 in the above title block.
The first draft initiated by eng. Shady Ghazy and tested by 
 maintenance manager eng. Ahmad Shanab and revised by maintenance general 
 manager: eng. Omran Abd El Hamid Shoaib approved by 
 Eng.Ahmed Sawan Nubria power station head sector and
 revised by MDEPC quality control eng. Abouda El Bana 
 &, and certified by eng. Samir Abd Algalil inspection & quality control 
 general director, MPIS coordinator approved by eng. 
 Mohamed Nagieb INSP. And quality control head sector
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be 
 issued and the qualified maintenance staff should be carry the
 Suitable safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with 
 caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety helmets, 
 shoes, earplug and gloves pairs.
Isolate the screen 
 mechanically and electrically.
Tools 
and Equipment
Maintenance tool set.
Wires to raise up the screen 
cover

cover
Work to be 
carried out
MAINTENANCE / 
 INSPECTION | CRITERIA FOR CORRECTIVE 
 ACTION | ACTION
Check spray pattern and cleaning action | Gaps in spray pattern caused by 
 clogged or broken nozzles | Clean or replace nozzles
Reduced 
 wash water volume or 
 pressure. | According to attachment 1
Reducer, motor and couplings | Excessive noise, vibration or heat 
 build up | According to attachment 1
Trays & screen cloth | Bent 
 frame, tears in cloth, missing 
 cloth fasteners | Replace 
 damaged or missing parts
Seal plates | Edge wear or side scoring | According to attachment 1
Tray to chain bolts | Loose or missing | Tighten or replace
Operation 
 of valves & 
 controls | Malfunction | According to attachment 2
Drive 
 chain and sprockets | Chain elongation (indicated by
 tendency of chain to jump teeth),
 excessive wear, stiff joints, corrosion, cracks, loose pins or 
 bushings | Replace chain
Sprocket side tooth wear | Align sprockets
Sprocket tooth hooking | Replace chain and sprocket
Sprocket wobbling or 
 broken teeth | Replace sprocket
Chain slack in excess of 1 
 (25 mm). | Adjust chain tightened to 
 reduce slack

Attachment 1
TROUBLE SHOOTING CHART 
FOR DUAL FLOW TRAVELING WATER SCREEN
MALFUNCTION | SYMPTOM | PROBABLE CAUSE | CORRECTIVE ACTION
SCREEN WILL NOT 
 OPERATE | MOTOR RUNS BUT 
 TRAYS DO NOT MOVE | Torque limiting coupling trips | Check path of chain and trays and
 remove any obstructions. Replace
 or repair any damaged parts torque coupling automatically resets. 
 Restart screen
Drive belts broken or slipping. | Replace or re tension belts
Internal failure of gear reducer
 (input shaft turns, but output shaft
 does not turn) | Remove gear reducer & 
 replace or repair
MOTOR STALLS | Wrong voltage applied to motor. | Have qualified electrician 
 check motors & electrical connections
MOTOR WILL NOT 
 RUN | Defective motor or improper
 electrical connection | Have qualified electrician check
 motor and electrical connections. 
 Replace motor if defective.
Differential control malfunction | Have qualified 
 electrician. Check differential control 
 instruments and wiring by others.
TRAYS NOT CLEAN | CARRYOVER OF 
 DEBRIS | Gaps in spray coverage due to
 clogged, worn, broken spray nozzle | Clean or replace sp ray nozzle
Misalignment of spray header | Align spray discharge by turning spray header 
 pipe.
Insufficient volume or 
 pressure or wash water due to clogged 
 spray header or supply pipe | Clean spray header & supply pipe
Insufficient volume or 
 pressure of wash water due to clogged strainer 
 element in supply line | Remove strainer element, 
 clean and reinstall (by others).
Insufficient volume or 
 pressure of wash water due to defective pump. | Check wash water pump output
No wash water due to 
 closed manual valve. | Open manual valve
No wash water due to 
 automatic valve malfunction | Check operation of 
 automatic valve. Replace or repair if 
 defective (by others).
IMPROPER TRAY 
 TRACKING | ERRATIC TRAY 
 LINE MOVEMENT | Improper chain tension - 
 too loose or too tight. | Adjust chain to proper tension
WEAR ON EDGE OF 
 SEAL PLATES | Head shaft out of level | Check level of head shaft.
 Correct by adjust. Take -up
Frame steel out of plumb | Shim to straighten and 
 plumb frame.
SPROCKET TEETH 
 OR CHAIN SIDE 
 BARS ON ONE 
 SIDE | Chain not centered on sprockets | Check level of head shaft.
 Correct by adjust. Take -up
UNUSUAL DRIVE 
 OPERATION | EXCESSIVE HEAT 
 BUILD-UP | Low oil level or improper 
 oil in gear reducer. | Add oil and refill 
 w/proper grade & quantity of oil.
EFFECTIVE NOISE 
 OR VIBRATION | Drive misalignment | Check path of chain & trays 
 & remove any obstructions.
Defective gear reducer | Remove gear reducer & 
 replace or repair
